# Roll Call

> > Roll Call delivers authoritative news and analysis on Congress, Capitol Hill politics, legislative activity, and federal government operations.

Roll Call is a premier source for political journalism covering the U.S. Congress, tracking legislative developments, election campaigns, and the inner workings of Washington. The publication provides in-depth reporting on policy debates, political figures like Donald Trump and congressional leaders, and major issues including healthcare reform, immigration policy, and Russia investigations.

## Key Topics

- Donald Trump
- Congress
- Republican Party
- Democratic Party
- Healthcare Reform
- Affordable Care Act (Obamacare)
- Russia Investigation
- Immigration Policy
- Senate
- House of Representatives
- White House
- Capitol Hill
- Congressional Elections
- Legislative Process
- Political Campaigns
